sentences.en: You've got to carry out your commitment at all costs.
sentences.zh: 你必须不惜一切代价履行你的承诺。

sentences.en: Layla knew that wearing the hijab was a big commitment.
sentences.zh: 莱拉知道佩戴面纱是一项重大的承诺。

sentences.en: Marriage succeeds only as lifetime commitment with no escape clauses.
sentences.zh: 只有在没有免责条款的情况下终身承诺才能使婚姻成功。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com（共同）+mit（送出）+ ment（表名词）→一起送出→委托
